note: LM-O (LineMOD-Occlusion), BOP test scene 000002, 1214 frames, 8 annotated objects. scene_camera.json carries NO cam_R_w2c/cam_t_w2c and the ground truth is annotated per image: measured inter-object distances drift by ~80 mm std across frames, so the scene is not rigid and NO global world frame or camera trajectory exists. The pose stream is therefore a fixed identity pose (world = camera) and the object memory is switched off — LM-O scores per-frame 6D pose only, which is what the BOP protocol asks of it.
prompt_note: Prompts chosen by objpose/tools/probe_bop_prompts.py: detector recall over 24 evenly spaced frames per object, images only (no pose ground truth).
ism_overrides_why: Measured on 40 frames of scene 000002: the per-box owner election (relative assignment, tuned on the 10 lab objects) gives every box to the single object with the highest DINOv2 semantic score, and on LM-O three of eight objects — cat, duck, holepuncher — then never receive a box at all (0 estimates in a full run). With it off all eight are estimated (191 vs 155 estimates, ADD-S 99.5% vs 98.1%). The ON run is kept as an ablation.
